distributionPlan.capitalPolicy: One existing named settlement designated Capital City per province; source capital status retained in its original province.
distributionPlan.provinceSizePolicy: Each province has 5 or 6 existing named settlements.
distributionPlan.townAvailability: 16 of 28 provinces include a Town (including Valerune); 12 cannot have one under the 10 percent total.
distributionPlan.disclosure: This is a gameplay redistribution; original province and settlement type remain in originalProvinceId/originalType and must not be mistaken for unchanged canonical geography.
